repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程智能体，支持终端和桌面应用。它通过命令行工具提供代码生成、编辑与自动化开发能力，兼容主流包管理器（npm、brew、scoop 等），并支持多语言界面。核心功能包括交互式编码、项目理解与重构，适用于开发者提升编程效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that functions as both a terminal tool and desktop application. It enables code generation, editing, and automation via CLI, supports multiple package managers (npm, brew, scoop), and offers multilingual interfaces. Key features include interactive development, project comprehension, and intelligent refactoring to enhance developer productivity.

repos.description: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,500+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300+ 插件（如 Git、Docker、Node.js）和 140+ 主题，支持自动更新。它通过丰富的扩展功能提升终端体验，让用户在开发效率与个性化之间获得平衡，同时保持轻量与易用性。
repos.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing zsh configurations, offering 300+ optional plugins (e.g., Git, Docker, Node.js) and 140+ themes, with auto-update support. It enhances terminal productivity and personalization through extensible plugins and beautiful themes, balancing power and simplicity for developers.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: Starship 是一款极简、极速且高度可定制的跨平台命令行提示符工具，支持任意 Shell（如 Bash、Zsh、Fish、PowerShell 等）。它通过 Rust 编写，性能卓越，能智能显示 Git 状态、编程语言版本、环境变量等上下文信息，极大提升终端使用效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable cross-shell prompt written in Rust. It intelligently displays contextual information like Git status, language versions, and environment variables across any shell (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, etc.), enhancing terminal productivity and aesthetics.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
repos.summary_zh: Herdr 是一个基于 Rust 构建的终端 AI 智能体运行时，支持多任务并行、会话持久化及跨设备重新连接。它提供原生终端视图与 Socket API，允许智能体间协作，并通过插件扩展工作流，专为开发者打造高效自动化环境。
repos.summary_en: Herdr is a Rust-based terminal runtime for AI agents, supporting multi-tasking, session persistence, and reattachment across devices. It offers native terminal views and a Socket API for agent collaboration, extensible via plugins, designed to build efficient automation environments for developers.

repos.description: Open-source Rust agent engine and terminal client for Codewhale, with provider choice, tools, approvals and receipts.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是开源终端编程智能体，用Rust构建，支持任意AI模型。它能读取项目、编辑文件、运行命令并验证结果，适用于自动化代码修复、测试调试与本地开发工作流，提供TUI交互与headless模式。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal, built in Rust and compatible with any AI model. It reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own work, suitable for automated code fixes, test debugging, and local development workflows, with TUI and headless modes.

repos.description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是一款基于Rust构建的开源终端AI编码代理，支持连接多种大模型提供商（含Ollama/vLLM本地部署），具备文件编辑、命令执行、任务规划等完整能力。采用分层审批机制保障执行安全，支持MCP协议扩展与Agent协作，可持久化会话与目标管理，适用于开发者终端工作流自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source Rust-based AI coding agent for the terminal, connecting to various LLM providers including local Ollama/vLLM deployments. It supports file editing, command execution, and task planning with tiered approval for safety. Features MCP extensibility, multi-agent coordination, and session persistence, ideal for developer terminal automation workflows.

repos.description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
repos.summary_zh: CodeWhale 是一款基于 DeepSeek V4 模型的终端编程智能体，支持流式推理输出、本地文件编辑（带审批机制）、Shell 命令执行、Git 操作及子代理协调。提供自动模式智能选择模型与思维层级，具备 1M 上下文窗口与缓存成本追踪，适用于高效终端开发辅助。
repos.summary_en: CodeWhale is a terminal-based coding agent powered by DeepSeek V4, featuring streaming reasoning blocks, local file editing with approval gates, shell/Git/web tools, and sub-agent coordination. It includes auto mode for dynamic model/thinking selection, 1M-token context support, and prefix-cache cost tracking for efficient development workflows.

repos.description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
repos.summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

repos.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
repos.summary_zh: Reasonix 是一款专为终端设计的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程智能体，基于前缀缓存稳定性优化，支持长时间运行且保持低 token 成本。其核心优势在于高达 99.82% 的缓存命中率，显著降低推理开销，适用于持续编码任务。
repos.summary_en: Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, engineered for prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions. It achieves up to 99.82% cache hit rate, drastically reducing inference expenses while enabling persistent, efficient development workflows.

repos.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-pi 是一款功能强大的终端 AI 编程代理，内置 31 种工具和 60+ 大模型支持。采用 Rust 核心构建，支持 LSP/DAP 操作、哈希锚定编辑与子代理协同，为开发者提供类 IDE 的智能编码体验。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-pi is a powerful terminal-based AI coding agent featuring 31 built-in tools and 60+ LLM providers. Built on a Rust core (~80k lines), it supports LSP/DAP operations, hash-anchored edits, and subagent orchestration, delivering IDE-grade intelligent coding directly in the terminal.

repos.description: Coding agent for DeepSeek models that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek TUI 是一款专为 DeepSeek V4 模型设计的终端原生编码代理，支持 1M 上下文窗口与实时思维链流式输出。集成文件操作、Shell 执行、Git 管理、Web 搜索、MCP 协议及 LSP 诊断等全套工具，提供 Plan/Agent/YOLO 三种交互模式，具备会话持久化、成本追踪与技能扩展能力，单二进制部署无需运行时依赖。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek TUI is a terminal-native coding agent optimized for DeepSeek V4's 1M-token context and prefix cache. It offers real-time chain-of-thought streaming, full tooling (file ops, shell, git, web, MCP), three interaction modes, session persistence, cost tracking, and extensible skills—all in a single binary with no runtime dependencies.

repos.description: JumpServer is an Open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform with AI-powered capabilities, providing DevOps and IT teams a unified workspace to securely access SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, websites, RemoteApp, VirtualApp, and more.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
repos.summary_zh: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: herdr 是一款运行在终端中的智能体多路复用器，支持工作区、标签页和窗格管理，提供鼠标交互、拖拽分割、实时状态查看（阻塞/工作中/完成）等功能。无需 GUI 应用，直接显示智能体原生终端输出，支持断开后重连且智能体持续运行。适用于 Linux 和 macOS 系统，可通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装。
repos.summary_en: herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that supports workspaces, tabs, and panes with mouse-native interactions like click, drag, and split. It displays real-time agent states (blocked, working, done) and shows the agent's native terminal output. Agents keep running after detach and can be reattached later. No GUI or Electron wrapper—works on Linux and macOS, installable via Homebrew or script.

repos.description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
repos.summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: Superset is an agentic IDE to orchestrate 100+ coding agents in parallel. Run any agent with your own subscription.
repos.summary_zh: Superset 是专为 AI 智能体时代设计的代码编辑器，支持在本地并行运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 编码代理。通过 Git 工作树隔离任务、内置终端与差异查看器，实现零切换成本的高效开发流程，显著提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI Agents Era, enabling parallel execution of multiple CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on your machine. It isolates tasks via Git worktrees, provides built-in terminal and diff viewer, and eliminates context-switching overhead to boost development efficiency.

repos.description: OpenTUI is a library to build terminal user interfaces (TUI)
repos.summary_zh: OpenTUI 是一个用 Zig 编写的高性能终端用户界面（TUI）核心库，提供 TypeScript 绑定和 C ABI 接口，支持多语言调用。其组件化架构与灵活布局能力适用于构建复杂终端应用，已用于 OpenCode 和 terminal.shop 生产环境。支持 React、SolidJS 等前端框架集成。
repos.summary_en: OpenTUI is a high-performance terminal UI (TUI) core library written in Zig, offering TypeScript bindings and a C ABI for cross-language compatibility. It features a component-based architecture with flexible layouts, enabling complex terminal applications. Used in production by OpenCode and terminal.shop, it supports integrations with React, SolidJS, and more.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: Rich MySQL Terminal Client with AutoCompletion, Syntax Highlighting, and Dataframes
repos.summary_zh: mycli 是一个专为 MySQL 设计的终端客户端，支持 SQL 关键字、表名、列名的智能自动补全和语法高亮。基于 prompt_toolkit 构建，提供模糊历史搜索、多行查询、查询收藏夹、执行时间统计、SSL 连接支持等功能，并可通过配置文件自定义行为，显著提升数据库交互效率。
repos.summary_en: mycli is a terminal client for MySQL featuring auto-completion for SQL keywords, tables, and columns, along with syntax highlighting. Built with prompt_toolkit, it offers fuzzy history search, multi-line queries, favorite query management, execution timing, SSL support, and customizable config via ~/.myclirc, enhancing database interaction efficiency.

repos.summary_zh: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
repos.summary_en: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: 🎃 A fast, out-of-the-box macOS terminal built for AI coding.
repos.summary_zh: Kaku 是一款专为 AI 编程优化的终端模拟器，基于 WezTerm 深度定制。它提供开箱即用的体验，支持零配置启动、主题自适应切换、内置 zsh 插件及轻量级高性能内核，并集成 AI 助手用于命令行错误修复与智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: Kaku is a high-performance terminal emulator built for AI coding, forked from WezTerm with deep customizations. It offers zero-config setup, theme-aware UI, integrated shell tools, and a built-in AI assistant for command recovery and coding support.

repos.description: Kode CLI — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode CLI 是一款面向后人类工作流的终端 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可自动理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并管理完整工作流。原生支持多平台与 20+ AI 模型，兼容 .claude 旧格式，具备子代理任务编排能力，适用于自动化编码与智能体协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Kode CLI is a terminal-based AI coding assistant designed for post-human workflows. It understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and manages full development workflows. It natively supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with 20+ AI models, and enables autonomous task orchestration via subagents.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: Kode Agent — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode 是一个终端中的强大 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并自动化完整工作流程。它兼容 Claude 的 .claude 格式，提供 YOLO 模式（默认）和安全的权限检查模式，支持 20+ AI 模型，具备原生二进制分发能力，注重隐私且无默认遥测。
repos.summary_en: Kode is a powerful AI coding assistant in your terminal that understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and automates workflows. It supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with .claude formats, offers YOLO and safe modes, works with 20+ AI models, and features native binary distribution with privacy-first design and no telemetry by default.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.description: worktree coding agents command center.
repos.summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.

repos.description: Visual design tool for building Terminal User Interfaces
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio 是一款类 Figma 的终端用户界面可视化设计工具，支持拖拽式组件编排、实时 ANSI 预览、多框架代码导出（Ink/BubbleTea/Textual 等），内置 20+ TUI 组件与丰富主题系统，提供绝对/弹性/网格布局引擎及完整撤销重做功能。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio is a Figma-like visual editor for designing Terminal UIs, featuring drag-and-drop components, live ANSI preview, multi-framework export (Ink/BubbleTea/Textual), 20+ built-in TUI elements, layout engines (absolute/flex/grid), and real-time theme switching with gradient support.

repos.description: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
repos.summary_zh: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

repos.description: QuietHarness：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 共用的轻量 AI 工作系统
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
repos.summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
repos.summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

repos.description: Agent-Native Terminal
repos.summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
repos.summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

repos.description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
repos.summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

repos.description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
repos.summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

repos.description: Deepin Terminal written by vala
repos.summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
repos.summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

repos.description: top, but for the HTTP endpoints on your host — a live dashboard of the most active plaintext HTTP endpoints, right in the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: httpinspect 是一款基于 eBPF 的终端实时监控工具，类比 top 命令，直接在内核 TC 层抓取网卡明文 HTTP 请求，按流量、速率和延迟排序展示活跃端点。无需代理、Sidecar 或修改应用代码，支持回环接口监控本地微服务通信，提供 p50/p95/max 延迟、状态码分布及每秒请求数等详细指标。
repos.summary_en: httpinspect is an eBPF-powered terminal live dashboard that ranks plaintext HTTP endpoints by traffic, rate, and latency — like top, but for HTTP. It attaches at the TC layer to read packets directly off the wire with no proxy, sidecar, or application changes. It covers loopback traffic for local microservice chatter and surfaces per-endpoint latency percentiles, status-code mix, and req/s sparklines in a TUI.

repos.description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
repos.summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
repos.summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
repos.summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

repos.description: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go) http://tui.studio
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.description: Natural language to shell command. Type what you want, get the exact command + explanation. Rust, 5.4MB, dual-request parallel.
repos.summary_zh: how2cli 是一款将自然语言实时转换为精确 Shell 命令的工具，支持 SSE 流式响应、会话记忆、Markdown 渲染及双模式（快速/推理）。基于 Rust 开发，单二进制部署，兼容任意 OpenAI API 端点，适用于 Linux 环境的高效命令行自动化。
repos.summary_en: how2cli is a natural language to shell command converter that instantly translates user queries into exact commands with explanations. Features SSE streaming, session memory, talk mode, dual models (fast/reasoning), and single-binary deployment in Rust. Compatible with any OAI-compatible API endpoint.
